name: חָם
summary: Ham is Noah's son and the father of Cush, Mizraim, Put and Canaan. The psalms call Egypt, the land of his son Mizraim, the land of Ham.

evidence.note: The verse names Shem, Ham and Japheth together and calls them בְּנֵי נֹחַ, sons of Noah.
The first וְחָם names Ham between Shem and Japheth among Noah’s sons who came out of the ark. The verse repeats his name in וְחָם הוּא אֲבִי כְנָעַן, identifying him as Canaan’s father.
The firstborn of Egypt are struck “in the tents of Ham”.
Jacob sojourns in the land of Ham.
Wonders in the land of Ham.

note: Merged with the former word entry `7aam`, the word “land of Ham” (old root key חמ), which added Egypt@Gen.12.10: TIPNR files the poetic name Ham under Egypt. The personal name owns the shared BDB key. The old `entry` named that word entry, which is now this name; there is no root entry. Not the place הָם (names/haam).
